vrchat.avatarChanged.description: Runs when you switch to another avatar in VRChat.

fields.avatar: Only react to these avatars, typed as their ids (they start with avtr_). Leave empty for any avatar.

variables.avatarId: The id of the avatar you switched to

vrchat.parameterChanged.description: Runs when one of your avatar's parameters changes, for example when you turn on a hat from your Action Menu. Movement and voice values that change many times a second are left out.

fields.parameter: Only react to these parameters, typed exactly as in your avatar. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any.
fields.value: Only react when it becomes this value, for example true or 3. Leave empty for any value.

variables.previousValue: Its value before (empty the first time)

vrchat.setParameter.description: Changes one of your avatar's parameters, for example to turn on a hat or change your outfit when someone redeems a reward.

fields.parameter: The parameter's name exactly as in your avatar (capital letters matter).
fields.type: The kind of parameter: Bool is on/off, Int is a whole number, Float is a number from -1 to 1. It must match your avatar.
fields.value: The new value. For Bool you can also type toggle to flip it.

vrchat.chatbox.description: Shows text in the chatbox above your avatar in VRChat. Everyone in your world can see it.

fields.text: What to show. Longer than 144 characters is cut off.
fields.immediately: Shows it straight away. Untick to put it in your keyboard so you can send it yourself.

vrchat.typing.description: Shows or hides the "typing..." bubble above your avatar.

fields.typing: Tick to show it, untick to hide it.

vrchat.getParameter.description: Finds out a parameter's value that VRChat last reported, so later steps can use it.

fields.parameter: The parameter's name exactly as in your avatar.
